Alphabet Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif. – October 29, 2026 – Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOG, GOOGL) today announced financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenues were $110.5 billion for the quarter, an increase of 25% year over year. Operating income was $30.1 billion and operating margin was 27%.
